title: Burnout Test
description: Measure your emotional exhaustion from work or school. Burnout isn't just physical tiredness; it's losing motivation and empathy.

questions.mbi_1: I feel emotionally drained by my work or studies.
questions.mbi_2: I feel completely used up at the end of the workday.
questions.mbi_3: I feel tired every morning when I wake up and have to face the same routine again.
questions.mbi_4: I can easily understand how my colleagues or clients feel and help solve their problems.
questions.mbi_5: I feel I treat some colleagues or clients as if they were objects (a loss of empathy).
questions.mbi_6: Dealing with people all day leaves me feeling fed up and pressured.
questions.mbi_7: I can deal with problems at work effectively.
questions.mbi_8: I feel out of breath and overwhelmed by what's happening at work.
questions.mbi_9: I feel I make a positive difference in other people's lives through my work.
questions.mbi_10: I've become more callous toward people since I took on this role.
questions.mbi_11: I worry that this work is hardening me emotionally (making me numb).
questions.mbi_12: I feel very energetic at work.
questions.mbi_13: I feel very frustrated and held back by this work.
questions.mbi_14: I feel I'm working too hard, beyond what I can handle.
questions.mbi_15: I no longer care at all about what happens to the place where I study or work.
questions.mbi_16: Working directly with people puts too much stress on me.
questions.mbi_17: I can easily create a relaxed atmosphere with my colleagues or friends.
questions.mbi_18: I feel happy when I see the work I've done come together.
questions.mbi_19: I feel I've accomplished many worthwhile things in my career or studies.
questions.mbi_20: I feel I'm at the end of my rope.
questions.mbi_21: At work or on campus, I deal with emotional problems very calmly.
questions.mbi_22: I feel colleagues or clients blame me for problems they created themselves.

results.description: Your stress is under control. You still have positive energy for your routine.
Cynicism and mental fatigue are starting to show and need attention soon, through time off or a detox.
You've run out of emotional fuel and feel empty or cynical. This is a red light for your mental health.
